title: pm-dispatch(mailbox): one mailbox PR per seat, a closed doorbell vocabulary (request / notify), alternate-pick for multi-seat lanes, and seat-online / seat-offline notices that wake the sibling seats and triage
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Filed by the `domain:skills#2` seat (`os-justin`, `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`, seat post #19287) from a design conversation with the maintainer in that session on 2026-10-28. ⛔ Not a claim; `domain:*` pre-labelled because every path below is in the skills tree — triage grades.

## The maintainer's words (verbatim, in order)

1. 「车道贴为什么不可以直接用 pr，订阅pr可以实时接收消息」 then 「车道之间可以互通」
2. 「我说的车道互通的意思是比如需要分诊紧急处理，没有fable了，需要请分诊复审，分诊审完了需要通知车道。比如main红了，需要协调谁来开发」
3. 「但是也要避免ai互聊信息太多爆炸，我觉得只沟通必要的信息。还有就是同一个车道分在几个不同 Claude code 账户的多个座位上，也是需要协调分工。座位下线的时候也是需要通知」
4. 「分诊席 和每个车道通常是长期开着的，只有账户没token了，会切换账户重开」
5. On the seat's proposal (B: keep the issue registration, make the mailbox PR per seat): 「B方案暂时是不是成本最低的，没有风险的」 → the seat's answer named three measured risks (below) → 「同意 信箱改每席一张」, then 「立卡」.

## Business reason

Only a PR wakes a session (`subscribe_pr_activity`); nothing on an issue does. Every cross-seat request today is a PULL: a `Contract-review-handoff:` line, a cross-seat note on a seat post, a p0 anchor card — read at the receiver's next patrol or summons. PR #26766 waited 9 h for a contract review nobody was woken for. The mailbox PR (`pm:mailbox`, `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`, `LEDGER_EXCLUSION`, filed by #25412/#25414) already exists as the wake channel, one per PROJECT, and 0 are open today. This card makes it one per SEAT and gives it a closed vocabulary, so the three cases the maintainer named become PUSH without AI-to-AI chatter.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:skills` seat, after #26997 lands (same protocol-text surface; serial). Tier S.

## What lands (one PR)

**A. One mailbox PR per seat** — `references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉: 「每项目至多一个 draft PR」 → one per seat (lane seat, triage seat, director seat), branch `mailbox/<login>` as today (per ACCOUNT: an account switch opens a new one and closes the old through the relay — the walled account writes nothing, the newcomer announces), labels `pm:mailbox` + `pinned`, body first line `To: <login>`, the seat post's stub carries the mailbox number as its pointer line. Never merged; closed on hand-over or account switch. The seated session subscribes to it (one subscriber per PR is the platform's shape and the wanted one).

**B. The closed doorbell vocabulary** — the first line of a mailbox comment is one of these keys and nothing else is allowed on a mailbox:

| First line | From → to | When |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `Request: contract-review · PR #n · head SHA · REASON` | lane → triage | the lane's review tier is unavailable (429 / exhausted); once per head |
| `Request: urgent-triage · #n · ONE-LINE-CRITERION` | any seat → triage | p0 suspect, main red, deterministic queue red |
| `Request: main-red · CHECK-NAME · anchor #n · suggested lane X` | the finding seat → triage (director when triage is absent) | the moment the p0 anchor card exists |
| `Notify: contract-review PASS or FAIL · PR #n · record ID` | triage → lane | the same act that lands the record (not sent when the lane already subscribes to that PR) |
| `Notify: seat-online · LANE#N · LOGIN · mailbox #m · takes: #a #b …` | the seating session → sibling seats of the lane + triage | the seating act (a takeover's newcomer sends it for the walled account) |
| `Notify: seat-offline · LANE#N · in-flight: … · stay-behind: … · brief ID` | the signing-off session → sibling seats + triage | the same act as the 收班简报 |
| `Notify: split · LANE#N · takes: … · leaves: …` | a seat of a multi-seat lane → its siblings | at round open, only when the list changed |

Hard rules (the anti-chatter half, maintainer's words 3): one event, one line, ≤200 bytes, only keys and numbers — reasons, readings and analysis stay on the card or PR; **no acknowledgements** (the action is the receipt: the record landed, the claim landed; the sender re-reads GitHub at its own next step, ⛔ never posts 收到/谢谢/请确认); **no re-send** of the same fact (one `Request` per head; no nagging — the existing escalation rules take over, e.g. a review a lane has not started in one round goes to triage); anything outside the table is a half-state the half-state patrol reports; ≤5 mailbox comments per seat per round, p0 exempt; every send counts against the write pace. A mailbox comment is a colleague's statement, ⛔ never an authorisation (untrusted-text.md's three sources are unchanged).

**C. Multi-seat lanes** — `references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉 one line: seats of one lane take candidates by **alternate pick** over the lane's priority order (seat 1 the 1st, 3rd, 5th …; seat 2 the 2nd, 4th, 6th …), hot-file serial unchanged; a `split` notice is sent only to break the alternation; the claim timestamp stays the tie-breaker.

**D. Online / offline** — `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 two lines: seating sends `seat-online`; the 收班简报 act sends `seat-offline`; a forced takeover's newcomer sends `seat-online` for the walled account (it can write nothing). The sentence 「分诊席跑直连会话 … ⛔ 无自醒不常驻」 is corrected to the maintainer's actual form (words 4): seats are long-lived; an account that runs out of tokens is replaced by a new account that reopens the seat and its mailbox.

**E. Recogniser** — `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` parses the seven keys (kind, numbers, sha, login, time) beside the records it already reads, with self-test cases; ⛔ no gate, workflow or queue guard reads a mailbox — coordination, not a merge condition.

**F. Workflows ring the doorbell too** (maintainer, 2026-10-28 ~06:4xZ, verbatim: 「把这一条补进 #27077」, on the triage seat's point that no seat watches a main push red, so a mailbox only helps if something rings it). The workflows that already file a red card send the matching `Request: main-red` line to the owning lane's mailbox and to triage's, in the same run that files or refreshes the card:
- `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` (the 4-hourly "red on main" card);
- `merge-queue-triage.yml` (the queue-flake anchor, on its first filing only, not on every refresh);
- a main **push** run that goes red with no anchor open for that check. This is a new step: today nothing files on a push red.
⛔ They write, never read: E's rule that no gate, workflow or queue guard reads a mailbox stands. One line per event, the same ≤200 B closed key. The suggested lane comes from the failing path, by the lane table. `.github/workflows/**` is Tier H, so F may land as a **second PR** after A–E, so the Tier S mailbox PR is not held behind a governed approval.

## Premises (each with its re-check)

- P1 — `stale.yml` closes a quiet PR: `days-before-pr-stale: 30`, `days-before-pr-close: 7`, `exempt-pr-labels: 'pinned,security,work-in-progress'` (no `pm:mailbox`). Re-check: `git show origin/main:.github/workflows/stale.yml | grep -n -E 'days-before-pr|exempt-pr-labels'`. Hence `pinned` on every mailbox; ⛔ no workflow edit (Tier H, not worth it).
- P2 — a PR body edit triggers `pr-body-guards.yml` (`types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]`); comments do not. The mailbox body is written once, so B pays nothing per message. Re-check: `git show origin/main:.github/workflows/pr-body-guards.yml | grep -n 'types:'`.
- P3 — one PR wakes one session at a time (platform). A new mailbox per account switch keeps the subscriber unambiguous. Re-check: the `subscribe_pr_activity` tool text in the session harness; no repo reading.
- P4 — the receiver is a resident session (words 4). A Routine seat (cron) cannot be woken; for it the hourly patrol reads the mailbox. Said in the text, not solved here.
- P5 — the mailbox tooling exists and is unused: `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` present, `LEDGER_EXCLUSION` appends `-label:pm:mailbox`, `GET /issues?state=open&labels=pm:mailbox` → 0 on 2026-10-28T04:3xZ. Re-check: that query plus `ls scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`.

## Relation to queued cards

#27062 (contract-review ownership: the lane reviews its own, triage takes a review nobody is doing, one claim line per head) and #27047 (p0 dispatch rules) are the RULES this channel carries; this card is the CHANNEL. They share `record-recognisers.mjs`; whichever lands second merges `origin/main` first. ⛔ This card does not restate their rules.

## Acceptance

- A reader of `project-forms.md` alone learns: one mailbox per seat, `pinned`, the seven keys, the four hard rules, the account-switch flow.
- `record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` parses one example of each key and refuses a free-text mailbox comment.
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose` green; the references pay their lines in place (0 headroom files: measure first).
- `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · Size S · Tier S (`.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`).

Dedupe (REST list, `labels=domain:skills`, open 27 + closed 400, grep `mailbox|信箱|doorbell|seat-offline|seat-online`): open → only seat post #19287 (this conversation's note); closed → #25412, #25414 (the mailbox's birth cards, one per project). **New.**
